## [1.2.2](https://github.com/VipinVIP/railone-patches/compare/v1.2.1...v1.2.2) (2026-10-29)

### 📱 Updated app support

* **RailOne 2.1.71:** All seven patches now apply to the latest Play Store release.

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Removes the FLAG_SECURE restriction that makes screenshots and screen recordings of the app come out black. The in-app WebView (WavesActivity) stops applying it, and the bundled no_screenshot plugin's own FLAG_SECURE hook is neutered so no screen can re-apply it.

patches.name: Bypass USB-debugging detection
patches.description: Forces the adb_enabled, adb_wifi_enabled and development_settings_enabled checks to return false, so the app runs normally while USB debugging / developer options are on.

patches.name: Bypass rjsniffer ADB check
patches.description: Neutralises the rjsniffer library's own adb_enabled check. It runs in the app's isolated :com.emrys.rjsniffer.rjsniffer.Sniffer process, independently of the main app.

patches.name: Bypass signature verification
patches.description: Forces the app's own signing-certificate check (SHA-256 of the APK signature) to return true, so a re-signed build is accepted by the Flutter layer.

patches.name: Disable native security SDK
patches.description: Stops AikyamApplication.onCreate() from loading libnative-lib.so, disarming the native anti-tamper SDK that force-stops the app and wipes its data. Root cause fix: the other patches only matter once this one is applied.

patches.name: Hide screenshot detection
patches.description: Stops the bundled no_screenshot plugin from registering its MediaStore ContentObserver, so screenshot and screen-recording detection never becomes active and no detection event is delivered to the app's Flutter layer.

patches.name: Monochrome icon support
patches.description: Adds the missing monochrome layer to the adaptive icon, so themed-icon launchers (Material You) can tint RailOne's icon instead of showing it untinted.
